text: Despite conflicting government reports, the weight of post-crisis evidence from leading financial economists supports the conclusion that hedge funds introduce at least some systemic risk into the financial system.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Timothy A. Krause, Hedge Funds and Systemic Risk (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2748096
abstract: Despite the mixed evidence produced by government reports on hedge funds' systemic risk, the majority of post-crisis evidence provided by leading financial economists suggests that hedge funds may play a role in introducing at least some systemic risk into the financial system.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: claim is qualified: some, not dominant, systemic risk
